fields.name: vehicle_id
fields.description: Stable identifier: firm_id, two hyphens, and a slug of fund_name.

fields.name: firm_id
fields.description: Firm managing the vehicle.

fields.name: generation_id
fields.description: Fund generation the vehicle belongs to.

fields.name: fund_name
fields.description: Legal or reported name of the vehicle.

fields.name: role
fields.description: Role of the vehicle within its generation.

fields.name: vintage
fields.description: Vintage year (first close or first sale).

fields.name: is_capital_deployed_row
fields.description: True for rows recording capital deployed in one calendar year (firms without a fund series); their timing weight is deployed_year_weight.

fields.name: committed_usd_m
fields.description: Committed capital (for "capital deployed" rows, capital deployed in that year). Unit: USD m.

fields.name: size_basis
fields.description: How the size was established (for example formd_sold, press_final_close, implied from holdings, estimate).

fields.name: strategy
fields.description: Investment strategy, which sets the deployment pace and stage mix used for capital at risk.

fields.name: mandate
fields.description: Mandate as researched (for example flagship, opportunity, seed, sector fund).

fields.name: geography
fields.description: Geographic mandate.

fields.name: in_scope
fields.description: Scope in the main specification: Y in capital at risk; N excluded (life-sciences, public-equity, credit, fund-of-funds and similar vehicles); S sensitivity only (renminbi, crypto, secondary or unclear vehicles).

fields.name: in_scope_as_researched
fields.description: Scope as originally researched, before review.

fields.name: life_sciences_share
fields.description: Estimated share of a generalist fund invested in life sciences (used only in a sensitivity check).

fields.name: size_confidence
fields.description: Confidence in committed_usd_m. Low-confidence sizes are halved and doubled in the ranges.

fields.name: capital_at_risk_usd_m
fields.description: committed_usd_m x timing_weight for in-scope vehicles; 0 otherwise. Unit: USD m.

fields.name: timing_weight
fields.description: Share of the vehicle's eventual listings expected to fall inside the 2014-2026 window (see timing_weights.csv).

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Main source (EDGAR Form D, press release, filing).

fields.name: note
fields.description: Evidence and reasoning behind the size, vintage and scope.
